posts.caption: Free medical health camp completed in Dinajpur: treated 180 mothers and children with essential vitamins and clean drinking water kits.
Distributed winter warm clothes and clean water to 350 families in Kurigram district today. All relief materials verified.

notices.title: Welcome to The Goodwill Network: Operational Registry Open
notices.content: The platform is initialized for live deployment. Non-profit organizations may submit their registration for verified listing. Registered NGOs receive 3 exemption donations before the standard bi-weekly maintenance fee cycle (৳250/14 days). Benefactors who log 5 or more verified contributions are automatically granted the Prominent Benefactor badge.
